name: Wand of Wonder

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Wonder
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: choose a target within 120 ft and roll on the Wand of Wonder table to see what happens.

summary: 7 charges: point it at a creature and something unpredictable happens (a d100 table).
text: As a Magic action, spend 1 of its 7 charges and pick a point, object or creature you can see within 120 feet, then roll 1d100 and look the result up in the Wand of Wonder table. Outcomes vary widely: the target might be slowed or limned by Faerie Fire, fireballs or lightning might erupt, butterflies might swarm, gas might billow, grass might sprout around you, or you might turn invisible. Any spell the wand casts uses save DC 15. It recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; when you spend the final charge, roll 1d20, and on a 1 it falls to dust and is destroyed.
